about: Yuken India Ltd was established in June 1976 with technical and financial collaboration of Yuken Kogyo Company Limited, Japan. It manufactures wide hydraulic equipment such as vane pumps, piston pumps, pressure controls, etc. It exports products to more than 19 countries. [1] [2]
